sealed.statement: On the declared five-node reference hardware class, a clean fixed-code representative rolling-restart window records at least fifteen runs, keeps corruption, unexpected node exit, oracle blindness, stale-source execution, acknowledged-write loss, and acknowledged-write verification gaps at zero in every run, and reports a Wilson-95 scenario-pass lower bound at or above the sealed T(5)=0.357 together with failure-class distribution and p50/p95 convergence time through the canonical stat-gate verdict.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

REUSED: execute scripts/rolling-restart-stat-gate.sh in certification mode, classify with scripts/rolling-restart-stat-gate-summary.js, read test/distributed/config/convergence-sealed-bars.json, calibrate through scripts/calibrate-machine.js, and project closure through the scenario-harness sealed-bar metric. Do not create a parallel gate, pass-rate calculator, safety classifier, oracle file, or timeout policy.

Every contributing run must use the same clean committed source fingerprint, five-node scenario configuration, workload, restart schedule, clean-start protocol, declared hardware class, resource limits, and machine-factor calibration. Reused containers, mixed fingerprints, dirty-source runs, and stale-source execution are non-contributing failures, never passes.

The certification window contains at least 15 runs and passes only when the canonical verdict is ABOVE_BAR with Wilson-95 lower bound >= 0.357. Consecutive passes are a liveness heartbeat only. If the N=15 interval is INCONCLUSIVE, additional runs may extend only that identical fixed-code window; the sealed bar may move upward only under docs/convergence-donewhen-metric.md and never downward.

Every contributing run must report CORRUPT=0, NODE_EXIT=0, ORACLE_BLIND=0, staleSource=0, acknowledgedWriteLoss=0, and acknowledgedWriteUnverified=0. One breach fails the entire window regardless of pass rate. Do not weaken readiness, durability, oracle coverage, source-fingerprint checks, or protocol timers.

Only work-bound convergence budgets may use the recorded machine factor. Quiet windows, sampling cadence, Raft protocol timers, correctness checks, and safety floors remain unscaled. Do not certify by increasing a raw timeout or lowering load.

Before the live window, run the latent-blocker census and gate:preflight with the exact milestone-certification question. The N>=15 window is a one-time representative certification, never the iteration loop or a mechanism-discovery tool.

A failed certification keeps its immutable outer verdict and is classified with the existing distributed-failure, causal-model, topology-convergence, priority-recovery, and liveness analyzers. Any product correction is a bounded child Quest with a deterministic red-on-revert reproduction at the owning invariant before another fixed-code certification window.

When a selected child theory crosses an owner, lifecycle, handoff, fairness, or coupled-invariant boundary, run npm run model:contracts and extend the existing TLA+/Alloy contract only when the current model cannot express the discriminator. A model result never substitutes for the live statistical verdict.

The doneWhen probe reads the newest canonical stat-gate aggregate and requires source commit/fingerprint, clean-tree receipt, config digest, hardware class, node count, workload and failure schedule identity, run count, safety counters, Wilson interval and sealed bar, failure-class distribution, p50/p95 convergence time, acknowledged-write visibility, and immutable contributing report paths. Narrative summaries and hand-authored oracle files cannot satisfy it.
